title: Everspin Demonstrates World’s First CXL-Connected Magnetoresistive Random-Access Memory
body_markdown:
By[Garth Miller](https://datacentredigest.com/author/garth/)


Data Centre Digest takes a closer look at Everspin’s CXL-connected MRAM demonstration and what persistent memory could add to the data center memory hierarchy. The platform pairs Everspin PERSYST MRAM with CXL connectivity, giving customers a way to evaluate MRAM alongside DRAM and NAND in their own systems.


The article explores potential uses including checkpointing and persistent key-value cache, particularly for AI infrastructure and data center workloads where retaining data through a power interruption or restart can matter.


[Read the full article in Data Centre Digest](https://datacentredigest.com/everspin-demonstrates-worlds-first-cxl-connected-magnetoresistive-random-access-memory/)
